acceptance: Reproduce with SparkAdapter.create_connection() on local Spark 4.2.0 / JDK 17 and record the stack trace.

After the fix, create_connection succeeds repeatedly in one process, a TPC-H SF0.01 power run on local Spark completes, and the live Spark plan hook uses the adapter's connection instead of a private session.
A regression test covers the drop-then-reconnect sequence.
context: Found during live plan parser validation (PR #3703). Not caused by that PR. Local only; no cloud.
description: While capturing live Spark plans locally (Spark 4.2.0 local[1], JDK 17), SparkAdapter.create_connection() failed with a null DAGScheduler after its drop-database step, so the live plan hook had to build its own SparkSession. Reproduce through the adapter's own connection path, find whether the session is stopped/reused after the drop, and fix so the adapter can run local Spark benchmarks and the live plan hook can use the adapter connection again.
